name: Rift Daemons of War
genericName: War Daemons||Daemon Champions of Conquest||Daemons of Wa'rghul
background:
The Rift Daemons are monstrous servants of the Havoc Gods, who emerge from beneath the surface of Tyria. Their forms vary greatly, depending on which god they serve, and they are accompanied by a variety of daemonic beasts. 

Daemons serve the strange and alien wills of their gods, emerging from the Great Rift and sewing Havoc throughout Tyria. The Daemons are cast offs of dying gods who desperately hope to buy more time for themselves, ready to leave nothing but havoc in their wake, just in hopes of extending their own lives for a little longer.
backgroundFull:
Rift Daemons are born from the last survivors of a pantheon of dying gods, known to Tyria as the Havoc Gods. Desperate to survive, these gods sought out followers from the lost and desperate, and offered them power in exchange for worship. Those who rejected these gods came to know them as Havoc Gods due to the zealotry of their followers and the unrest that they caused. 

The Havoc Gods came to Tyria soon after Voidgates had been discovered. As mages and adventurers activated Voidgates throughout the land, the influence of Havoc began to spread. The Havoc Gods saw Tyria as a fascinating plane due to the diversity of its peoples, where they could find all sorts of different new followers. 

Daemons were sent into Tyria by their gods, spreading throughout the plane. They sought out followers for their Gods, either through promises of power, or shows of force. They found followers throughout Tyria, whom they guided to conquer others. Treachery, war, and bloodshed became commonplace as the Havoc Wars began. Daemons were seen throughout the continent, fighting alone or alongside mortal allies, as they and their masters threatened to overrun the plane.

The Havoc Gods were on the verge of victory when they fell into a desperate trap set by their enemies. The most powerful mages of Tyria gave their lives in a ritual that managed to seal the Havoc Gods into the Orb of Fate. Suddenly severed from their creators, the forces of Havoc were defeated. The surviving Daemons fled and hid throughout Tyria, escaping wherever they could, while their foes enjoyed an era of peace and prosperity. 

This peace was brought to an abrupt end when, centuries later, the orb was broken by the heirs of the most powerful Human Empire in Tyria. The Havoc Gods were freed, and the power unleashed by the broken orb tore through the heart of Tyria, scarring the land and opening a massive fissure, cutting through much of the plane. This great scar became known as the Rift, and from it, the Daemons began to emerge once more into Tyria. 

The Rift Daemons are eager to return to their masters and avenge their defeat. They have already spread throughout many corners of Tyria, and their hordes grow steadily with each passing day. With their old foes complacent and divided, there are few who can stand against them while they are ready to once more bend Tyria to the will of their gods. 

How will you bring glory to your god?

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: When this model attacks, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unique
specialRules.description: This hero may only be taken once per party.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Warbound Boost
specialRules.description: If this model has Warbound, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, enemies taking wounds from it take extra wounds on failed defense rolls of 1-2 from Warbound (instead of only on 1).

specialRules.name: Warbound
specialRules.description: Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Defensive Frenzy
specialRules.description: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of six markers. For every three markers all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to Defense rolls. All markers are removed once the next wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Crack
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Piercing Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 friendly units picked before the start of the game get AP(+1) in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule. This effect lasts until the first wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Fatigue Debuff
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 4 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed, it becomes fatigued.

specialRules.name: Bounding Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule. This effect lasts until the first wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Reckless Piercing Aura
specialRules.description: This model and up to 3 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Reckless Piercing. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule. This effect lasts until the first wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Piercing Shooter
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when shooting.

specialRules.name: Storm of War
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per game, when this model is activated, before attacking, roll 3 dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with AP(1).

specialRules.name: Violent
specialRules.description: Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: +1 to Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position.

specialRules.name: Reckless Piercing
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, you may roll one die. On a 2+ their weapons get AP(+1) when attacking until the end of the round, but on a 1 enemy units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them instead.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (players pick how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it.
